name: cloud
description: Cloud models on AWS Bedrock (paid per token): GPT-6.1 Sol on Codex builds, Claude Haiku 5.5 on Cline reviews (another vendor), Claude Opus 5.5 on Cline plans, Kimi K3 on Codex is the fallback dev model. The fallback starts without asking, so Kimi K3 runs and costs without approval

dev.note: every dev card: GPT-6.1 Sol on Codex; this preset is selected explicitly per project

qa.note: every QA card: Claude Haiku 5.5 on Cline (user 2026-10-12): another vendor (anthropic) than the Sol dev model (openai) and the Kimi fallback model (moonshotai)

plan.note: every plan card: Claude Opus 5.5 on Cline in its plan mode (--plan) (user 2026-10-12)

fallback.note: the fallback dev model: Kimi K3 on Codex (user 2026-10-12), a third vendor, so its sibling is still reviewed by Haiku; paid, and started without approval

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (Claude Opus 5.5 on Cline) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).
